title: Port immutable receipt-chain timeline, detail, copy, links, and export

commands.result: passed: Next.js production build; existing autoprefixer warning only
passed: 1 test using supervised production server and system Chrome

assertions: ReceiptChain uses deterministic provenance-rich seed data with current, broken, stale, and unverified states.
Timeline selection is URL-safe, keyboard traversable, and has an accessible list fallback.
Copy announcement, related job/predecessor links, and scoped expiring export exclude private paths and tenant identifiers.
Broken and unverified chains visibly block approval-dependent actions; verification is not inferred from hash alone.
Exactly 14 unique admin_receipts source controls are projected and no edit/delete surface exists.
verification_notes: Focused E2E exercises all 14 unique controls, list fallback, copy announcement, safe download, URL selection, keyboard traversal, broken/stale/unverified states, and absence of edit/delete controls. Source diagnostics are clean; E2E diagnostics timed out in the environment.
